description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Prompto
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Crackshot (0~2), removed after using Crackshot two times

description.name: Crackshot Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Crackshot level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Prompto]

description.name: Crackshot Level
description.text: Keeps track of Crackshot level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Prompto]
